searchText: Does anybody read this message.? Or there is no answer for this question? This server is for Ethereum research and protocol development. You’re not getting answers because you’re in the wrong place. Please ask in the support channels for your particular execution client. Thanks, will do. Does the implementation of Verkle trie in the EL client eliminate the need for optimistic mode or syncing on the CL side? If it does, can we remove this in the same fork, or must it be done in a fork upgrade? I want to verify the accuracy of the statement that the CL is not affected by the Verkle trie. However, if it enables us to deprecate optimistic syncing, that would be awesome
